name: What factors determine the cost of installing new bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of installing new bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends primarily on your bathroom's square footage, the material selected, and necessary subfloor preparation. Tile projects generally carry higher costs due to extensive labor, including underlayment installation, precision cutting around drains, and grouting. Luxury vinyl plank has lower labor and material costs. Additional expenses arise if old tile must be torn out or if water damage under the toilet or tub requires replacing rotted plywood before the new surface can be laid down.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs are driven by room size, material type, tear-out labor, and subfloor conditions, especially if previous moisture leaks require structural wood replacement.
